name: VibeWave v2.4.4 - Mega 8-Feature Update!
body:
### 🚀 VibeWave v2.4.4 - 8 Dhamakedar Naye Features!

1. ⚡ **Quick Category Chips:** Home screen par instant chips (Trending India, Bollywood Hits, Punjabi Beats, Bhojpuri Dhamaka, Bhakti, Lo-Fi, Desi Hip-Hop, Krishna Flute).
2. 🌙 **1-Tap Slowed + Reverb & Bass Boost:** Player 3-dots me 1-click se Slowed + Reverb aur Bass Boost effect lagayein!
3. ⏰ **Quick Sleep Timer:** 15m, 30m, 45m, 60m direct 1-tap sleep timer.
4. 📶 **Offline Mode Switch:** Library me 1-tap Downloaded Songs filter.
5. 📸 **WhatsApp / Instagram Story Card:** Gaane ka mast visual card 1-click me story par share karein!
6. 🔔 **Set as Phone Ringtone:** Kisi bhi song ko direct phone ki ringtone banayein!
7. 🎧 **HQ 320 kbps Audio Badge:** Player par stylish audio badge aur Hi-Fi specs dialog.
8. 📳 **Shake to Skip:** Phone hilate hi agla gana bajega!
